Synopsis:
    British crypto entrepreneur Ben Delo, co-founder of BitMEX and recipient of a Trump presidential pardon, is donating a record £36M to Reform UK at £1M/month ahead of the 2029 UK general election. The donation comes as Reform, led by Nigel Farage, faces reputational pressure from alleged electoral law violations by senior aides. Delo frames the donation as enabling Reform to focus on policy development rather than fundraising, and as leveling the playing field against Labour and the Conservatives.

Relevance: NO — story is centered on UK domestic politics and party financing; US angle is limited to Delo's prior BitMEX conviction and Trump pardon as background context only.
